ug_anomaly-0.title: Kola Superdeep Borehole and the "Well to Hell"
ug_anomaly-0.summary: A Soviet scientific borehole that reached 12,262 m in 1989, the deepest hole ever drilled. It is famous for the "Well to Hell" hoax: a story, first printed in a Finnish Pentecostal newsletter and spread by the US Trinity Broadcasting Network, that drillers in Siberia broke into a cavity and recorded screams of the damned. Debunked: the recording was looped from sound effects (often identified as the 1972 film Baron Blood), and the real drilling reported geological surprises but nothing supernatural.
evidence: Borehole site still exists, welded shut.
ug_anomaly-0.license: Summary written for Anomaly Atlas from the linked sources; Wikipedia text is CC BY-SA 4.0.

breakdown: Confirmed hoax or fabrication: "Well to Hell" recording is a sound-effects hoax

rumors.text: Drillers broke into hell and recorded screams of the damned.

ug_anomaly-0.depth_label: 12,262 m true vertical depth (reached 1989), the deepest human-made hole

ug_anomaly-1.title: Derinkuyu underground city
ug_anomaly-1.summary: An ancient multi-level city cut into soft rock, about 85 m deep and big enough to shelter up to 20,000 people with livestock and food. It was forgotten until 1963, when a resident renovating his house broke through a wall into a hidden room. A well-documented refuge carved into the rock by people, later abandoned.
evidence: Open to visitors; more than 600 entrances found.
ug_anomaly-1.license: Summary written for Anomaly Atlas from the linked sources; Wikipedia text is CC BY-SA 4.0.

breakdown: Identified / explained (conventional cause): Human-made refuge city

ug_anomaly-1.depth_label: About 85 m deep, on many levels

ug_anomaly-2.title: Mel’s Hole (claimed bottomless pit)
ug_anomaly-2.place: Claimed: about 14 km west of Ellensburg, Kittitas County, Washington, USA
ug_anomaly-2.summary: Claimed by a caller identifying himself as "Mel Waters" on the Coast to Coast AM radio show in 1997: a hole on his rural land with no measurable bottom, with strange effects on animals and radios. Contested/unsupported: later investigation found no such person living there and no credible evidence the hole ever existed.
ug_anomaly-2.license: Summary written for Anomaly Atlas from the linked sources; Wikipedia text is CC BY-SA 4.0.

breakdown: Disproven by later evidence: No hole or claimant found

rumors.text: The hole is bottomless and the government seized the land.

ug_anomaly-3.title: Dulce Base (claimed underground alien base)
ug_anomaly-3.place: Archuleta Mesa near Dulce, New Mexico, USA
ug_anomaly-3.summary: A conspiracy theory claiming a joint human and alien facility deep under Archuleta Mesa. The claims began with Albuquerque businessman Paul Bennewitz, who from 1979 believed he was intercepting alien transmissions and later that he had found the base. No evidence of such a base has been found.

breakdown: Disproven by later evidence: No evidence of any facility

ug_anomaly-4.title: Hollow Earth polar openings (claim)
ug_anomaly-4.place: Claimed openings at the poles (pin placed near the North Pole; illustrative)
ug_anomaly-4.summary: Claimed by John Cleves Symmes Jr. in 1818: Earth is a hollow shell about 1,300 km thick with openings some 2,300 km across at both poles. Later writers, such as the 1964 book The Hollow Earth, claimed UFOs come from inside. Disproven: gravity and seismic measurements show a dense, solid and liquid interior; the idea survives as folklore and fiction.
ug_anomaly-4.license: Summary written for Anomaly Atlas from the linked sources; Wikipedia text is CC BY-SA 4.0.

breakdown: Disproven by later evidence: Contradicted by seismology and gravity data

rumors.text: Flying saucers come from a civilization inside the hollow Earth.

ug_anomaly-4.depth_label: Symmes claimed a shell about 1,300 km thick; illustrative, not a real depth

ug_anomaly-5.title: Hang Sơn Đoòng (world’s largest cave)
ug_anomaly-5.place: Phong Nha–Kẻ Bàng National Park, Vietnam
ug_anomaly-5.summary: The world’s largest natural cave, with a fast underground river and the largest cross-section of any known cave passage. A local man found the entrance in 1990 while searching for agarwood but was put off by the roar of water and wind; British cavers surveyed it in 2009. A natural wonder rather than an unexplained event, included for its scale.
evidence: 2009 BCRA survey: volume about 38.5 million m³.
ug_anomaly-5.license: Summary written for Anomaly Atlas from the linked sources; Wikipedia text is CC BY-SA 4.0.

breakdown: Identified / explained (conventional cause): Natural limestone cave

ug_anomaly-6.title: Lake Vostok (sealed subglacial lake)
ug_anomaly-6.place: Under the East Antarctic Ice Sheet, Antarctica
ug_anomaly-6.summary: A huge lake under almost 4 km of Antarctic ice whose water may have been cut off for 15 to 25 million years. Russian scientists drilled through to its surface on 5 February 2012. It is studied as a model for ice-covered oceans on Europa and Enceladus; internet claims of hidden bases or strange signals there have no support in the source.
ug_anomaly-6.license: Summary written for Anomaly Atlas from the linked sources; Wikipedia text is CC BY-SA 4.0.

breakdown: Identified / explained (conventional cause): Natural subglacial lake

ug_anomaly-6.depth_label: Lake surface reached at 3,768 m of ice (5 February 2012)

ug_anomaly-7.title: Mount Shasta tunnels and Telos (claim)
ug_anomaly-7.summary: Claimed by Frederick Spencer Oliver’s 1894 occult book A Dweller on Two Planets: survivors of the lost continent Lemuria live in a complex of tunnels under Mount Shasta, later called the city of Telos. No evidence exists; the Lemuria idea itself was discredited by the discovery of plate tectonics and continental drift.
ug_anomaly-7.license: Summary written for Anomaly Atlas from the linked sources; Wikipedia text is CC BY-SA 4.0.

breakdown: Disproven by later evidence: No evidence; Lemuria hypothesis abandoned

rumors.text: Lemurians live in a crystal city called Telos under the mountain.

ug_anomaly-8.title: Movile Cave (ecosystem sealed for 5.5 million years)
ug_anomaly-8.summary: Found in 1986 during construction work: a cave cut off from the surface for about 5.5 million years, with a unique ecosystem powered by chemosynthesis instead of sunlight, in air rich in hydrogen sulfide and carbon dioxide. Access is strictly controlled.

ug_anomaly-9.title: Darvaza gas crater ("Door to Hell")
ug_anomaly-9.summary: A natural-gas cavern whose roof collapsed after drilling and has been burning since 1971, its floor and rim lit by hundreds of fires. Accounts differ: some say Soviet engineers drilling in 1971 set it alight to stop poisonous gas spreading, others that the collapse came in the 1960s and the fire in the 1980s.

breakdown: Identified / explained (conventional cause): Burning natural-gas field

ug_anomaly-10.title: Oak Island Money Pit
ug_anomaly-10.summary: According to the often-retold story, in 1795 a local youth noticed a depression and dug with two friends, finding flagstones and, about 3 m down, a layer of oak logs. Treasure hunters have dug there ever since. Contested: no treasure has been found, and the legend is part of North American folklore; repeated excavations have not resolved it.
ug_anomaly-10.license: Summary written for Anomaly Atlas from the linked sources; Wikipedia text is CC BY-SA 4.0.

rumors.text: Pirate or Templar treasure is buried at the bottom of the pit.

ug_anomaly-10.depth_label: First "oak log" layer reported about 3 m down (1795 story); later shafts went far deeper

ug_anomaly-11.title: Ravne tunnels (Bosnian pyramid claims)
ug_anomaly-11.summary: Claimed by businessman Semir Osmanagić since 2005: natural hills near Visoko are giant ancient pyramids, linked by the "Ravne tunnels". Refuted: scientists overwhelmingly reject the claims; the hills are natural formations, and the site is now a New Age attraction.

ug_anomaly-12.title: Denver airport tunnels (conspiracy claims)
ug_anomaly-12.summary: Conspiracy theories claim tunnels under the airport lead to bunkers for the elite, military bases, or homes for aliens and "lizard people". Explained: the tunnels exist, but their scope is exaggerated; they were built to move luggage between check-in, planes and baggage claim.

rumors.text: The tunnels lead to bunkers for the elite or alien homes.

ug_anomaly-13.title: Centralia mine fire
ug_anomaly-13.summary: A coal-seam fire has burned in abandoned mines under Centralia since at least 27 May 1962 and could last another 250 years. Its exact cause is still debated. In 1981 a boy fell into a sinkhole about 46 m deep that opened in a backyard and was pulled out by his cousin; the town was later largely abandoned.
ug_anomaly-13.license: Summary written for Anomaly Atlas from the linked sources; Wikipedia text is CC BY-SA 4.0.

breakdown: Partly explained / leading theory accepted by many researchers: Fire is real; ignition cause debated

ug_anomaly-13.depth_label: Burning at depths of up to about 90 m

ug_anomaly-14.title: Yamal craters
ug_anomaly-14.summary: In 2014 a crater-like sinkhole that looked like the result of a large explosion was found on the Yamal Peninsula, drawing worldwide attention; several hypotheses were proposed for how it formed. The region is permafrost ground rich in natural gas.
